newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt state offers investors 60 pct in Egytrav.
newsitem.headline: Egypt state offers investors 60 pct in Egytrav.

text.p: The Egyptian state said in an announcement published on Sunday it was offering private investors and institutions 180,000 shares or 60 percent of subsidiary Egypt Transport and Travel Services (Egytrav).

An official at the holding company for Housing, Tourism and Cinema said the shares would be offered at an initial price of 10 pounds ($2.95) per share. Investors can bid for as many shares as they want, the official added.
The deadline for bids is noon (0900 GMT) on August 7. The sale is part of the government's privatisation-led economic reform programme.
The holding company said it had established Egytrav to develop touristic and travel services, as well as help set up parking facilities.
